#!/bin/zsh
#FLUX: --account=VeloC
#FLUX: --nodes=8
#FLUX: --ntasks=64
#FLUX: --time=00:10:00
#FLUX: --queue=full-node
#FLUX: --mail-user=thomas.bouvier@inria.fr
#FLUX: --mail-type=ALL

# The Cobalt directive '--attr filesystems=home' is a site-specific constraint
# with no direct Flux equivalent. If this feature is required, a corresponding
# site-specific '--constraint' option may be needed for Flux.
# The performance-related OpenMPI option '-map-by slot' was omitted.
# Flux's default task distribution will be used, which may have different
# performance characteristics.

set -eu

# note: disable registration cache for verbs provider for now; see
#       discussion in https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/5244
export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0
# use shared recv context in RXM; should improve scalability
export FI_OFI_RXM_USE_SRX=1

echo "Setting up spack"
source ${HOME}/git/spack-thetagpu/share/spack/setup-env.sh
echo "Activating env"
spack env activate /home/tbouvier/git/spack-envs/thetagpu

export WANDB_MODE=offline
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib64;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/lib;/lus/theta-fs0/software/thetagpu/openmpi/openmpi-4.1.4_ucx-1.14.0_gcc-9.4.0_cuda-11.4/lib;/usr/local/cuda-11/lib64"

# Jobs are run from the xps/thetagpu dir, main.py is at location ../..
# The 'mpiexec' command has been replaced with 'flux run'.
# The '-hostfile' option is not needed as Flux manages the node list.
# The '-bind-to none' option is translated to '--cpu-affinity=off'.
# Environment variables are exported in the script, so '-x' flags are unnecessary.
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx flux run -n 64 --tasks-per-node=8 --cpu-affinity=off python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config er_ghostnet_scale --log-level info --nsys-run

issues: The script contains hardcoded paths specific to a user ('/home/tbouvier/...'), which limits its portability. Using environment variables like $HOME or relative paths would improve reusability.

The LD_LIBRARY_PATH is set manually with a long, hardcoded string. This is fragile and difficult to maintain. A better practice would be to manage the environment using a module system or a Spack view.

The `flux run` command specifies `-n 64` and `--tasks-per-node=8`. This is redundant as these are already defined by the `#FLUX` directives at the top of the script. While this is not an error because the values match, Flux would already enforce this layout based on the job allocation.

#!/bin/zsh
#COBALT -A VeloC
#COBALT -n 8
#COBALT -t 0:10:00
#COBALT --mode script
#COBALT -q full-node
#COBALT --attr filesystems=home
#COBALT -M thomas.bouvier@inria.fr

set -eu

# note: disable registration cache for verbs provider for now; see
#       discussion in https://github.com/ofiwg/libfabric/issues/5244
export FI_MR_CACHE_MAX_COUNT=0
# use shared recv context in RXM; should improve scalability
export FI_OFI_RXM_USE_SRX=1

echo "Setting up spack"
source ${HOME}/git/spack-thetagpu/share/spack/setup-env.sh
echo "Activating env"
spack env activate /home/tbouvier/git/spack-envs/thetagpu

export WANDB_MODE=offline
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib64;/home/tbouvier/view/thetagpu/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/lib;/lus/theta-fs0/software/thetagpu/openmpi/openmpi-4.1.4_ucx-1.14.0_gcc-9.4.0_cuda-11.4/lib;/usr/local/cuda-11/lib64"

# Jobs are run from the xps/thetagpu dir, main.py is at location ../..
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx mpiexec -np 64 -npernode 8 -hostfile $COBALT_NODEFILE -bind-to none -map-by slot -x NCCL_DEBUG=INFO -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH -x WANDB_MODE -x PATH python ../../main.py --yaml-config experiments_thetagpu.yaml --config er_ghostnet_scale --log-level info --nsys-run
